description: A custom Android View class implementing an interactive line chart with zooming, panning, and gesture support for the function x^3 - x/4.

classes.name: InteractiveLineGraphView
classes.description: A custom Android View for rendering and interacting with a line chart of the function x^3 - x/4, supporting zoom, pan, and gesture interactions.

classes.name: SavedState
classes.description: A Parcelable class for saving and restoring the view's state, including the current viewport.

classes.name: AxisStops
classes.description: A helper class representing axis label stops, including stop values, count, and decimal precision.

methods.name: initPaints
methods.description: Initializes Paint objects based on current attribute values.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles size changes to update content rectangle.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view size, ensuring minimum chart size.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders axes, grid lines, labels, data series, and edge effects.

methods.name: drawAxes
methods.description: Draws chart axes, grid lines, and labels.

methods.name: formatFloat
methods.description: Formats float values into character arrays with specified decimal precision.

methods.name: computeAxisStops
methods.description: Calculates axis label stops within given start and stop boundaries.

methods.name: getDrawX
methods.description: Converts a chart X value to pixel coordinate.

methods.name: getDrawY
methods.description: Converts a chart Y value to pixel coordinate.

methods.name: drawDataSeriesUnclipped
methods.description: Draws the function curve based on current viewport.

methods.name: drawEdgeEffectsUnclipped
methods.description: Draws overscroll glow effects at edges if needed.

methods.name: hitTest
methods.description: Checks if a pixel coordinate is within the chart region and maps it to chart data point.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events for gestures.

methods.name: constrainViewport
methods.description: Ensures the viewport stays within defined axis limits.

methods.name: getCurrentViewport
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current chart viewport.

methods.name: setCurrentViewport
methods.description: Sets the chart viewport to a specified rectangle.

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: Smoothly zooms into the chart.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Smoothly zooms out of the chart.

methods.name: panLeft
methods.description: Pans the chart left.

methods.name: panRight
methods.description: Pans the chart right.

methods.name: panUp
methods.description: Pans the chart upward.

methods.name: panDown
methods.description: Pans the chart downward.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the view state, including current viewport.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the view state from saved data.
